content: Bumblebee is Elixir's main path for running HF transformer models in-process via Nx.Serving; Ortex (ONNX Runtime wrapper) is a lighter alternative that also implements Nx.Serving and is recommended by DockYard for smaller pre-trained ONNX models when Bumblebee's fuller feature set (esp. GPU/EXLA-oriented) is unneeded. For CPU-only small encoder/embedding models (MiniLM/BGE-class, which is the relevant class for a ~400-game Spanish catalog), ONNX Runtime with int8 quantization gets sub-20ms single-item CPU inference in other-language benchmarks (nixiesearch: ~10ms for a 500M model quantized) — supports the PROJECT.md assumption that local CPU embeddings are viable on the Hetzner CAX31 ARM node without GPU, though ARM-specific ONNX Runtime perf should still be spiked (already flagged as Phase 2's first task in PROJECT.md).
